OUT-OF-BAND LANDING ON main, 2026-08-19: ca6f34310 IS ON main WITH NO QUEUE ROW. "book: close The Adit -- chronicle, retrospective, registry flip", pushed directly. Recording it because the mouth's own exit-4 comment says an out-of-band landing must reach a human whether or not anything broke — the queue's inductive guarantee ("every commit on main was gated as the merge product") is what is damaged, and that is invisible in the artifact.

NOTHING BROKE. Measured after the fact, on main's new tip:

  cargo test -p hornvale --test docs_consistency   -> 23 passed, 0 failed
  mdbook build book                                -> rc=0
  git diff --exit-code -- $(grep -v '^#' docs/generated-paths.txt) -> no drift

HOW IT SURFACED, which is the part worth reusing: not by a gate. `make worktree-take NAME=... BASE=main` branches from `origin/$BASE`, so my new branch came up 1 ahead of my local main carrying a commit I never merged. That is a free out-of-band detector for anyone taking a worktree — if `git rev-list --left-right --count main...HEAD` is not `0 0` on a freshly-taken worktree, something landed that you did not fetch, and it may not have a queue row. Check `bash scripts/sluice-queue.sh list | tail` against `git log <last-landed>..origin/main`.

TWO THINGS THAT DID NOT STOP IT, both by design and both worth knowing:

1. THE pre-push HOOK DOES NOT COVER THIS CASE. fix/pre-push-chamber-guard refuses a push to refs/heads/main only WHILE THE CHAMBER HOLDS THE CLAIM. The box was idle, so the push was allowed. The hook closes the race (a push killing a candidate mid-merge, which cost an hour to learn); it is NOT a general no-direct-push enforcement, and reading it as one would be a false sense of cover.

2. THE COST ARGUMENT FOR GOING AROUND THE QUEUE IS GONE. Prose-only candidates now skip seam-guard/clients/heavy, so this commit through `make sluice` was ~7 min, not ~60. That is precisely what makes the policy reasonable rather than ceremonial.

The commit itself is fine and stays. No revert, no red. Attribution is to a process gap, not to The Adit's work, which gated clean as req-8473f2e8082a (all six phases rc=0).
